resources.string: Microphone access is used exclusively during active live voice calls with your Ideal Self companion so you can speak naturally and interrupt at any time.
Bluetooth audio access allows hands-free voice sessions to route seamlessly to your wireless headphones or earbuds.

Your Ideal Self profile, conversations, and selective memories are isolated under your Google account via zero-trust Firestore rules. You can inspect, edit, or permanently delete all cloud data at any time.
